reply: 好的凯哥，以下是dark mode toggle的PR描述草稿：

## Title: Add dark mode toggle to user settings

## Summary
Implements a manual dark mode toggle in user settings, allowing users to switch between light and dark themes. Based on beta feedback (87% satisfaction, 82% prefer toggle), this is Phase 1 delivery for Nov 11 target.

## Changes
- Added toggle switch in Settings > Appearance
- Dark mode persisted via user preference (local storage + backend sync)
- Updated UI components to respect theme variable
- Added analytics event tracking for toggle usage

## Risk
- Potential style inconsistencies on legacy pages — QA should verify across all modules
- No auto-toggle based on system preference (planned for Phase 2)
- Performance impact minimal (CSS variable switching only)

## Testing
- 50 beta users confirmed toggle works across devices
- A/B test data TBD post-launch
